title: Here's how you can stay the night in one of the UK's most haunted homes
excerpt: Stay at The Cage, one of England’s most haunted houses, in St Osyth, Essex, as Amy’s Crypt opens the historic lock-up for overnight stays from November 2026.
content:
Paranormal fans can now spend the night at one of England's most haunted houses in Essex.

YouTube channel Amy’s Crypt, run by Amy Waine and husband Jarrad, bought The Cage in St Osyth last year.

After restoring and revamping the property, the couple have opened it for overnight stays.

The historic former village lock-up is known nationwide for reported ghostly activity and links to the village’s infamous witch trials.

Paranormal - Jarrad and Amy in front of the home's famous sign (Image: Amy's Crypt)

The property, which sleeps up to four adults, has been transformed into an immersive visitor experience while retaining its historic character.

Guests will find period-inspired furnishings and artefacts exploring England’s lock-ups and cages, the history of St Osyth and its infamous witch trials.

The attraction also features a museum displaying more than 100 historic artefacts and curiosities, and a library dedicated to books on the paranormal, witchcraft and occult.

Excited - the couple purchased the haunted house in 2025 (Image: Amy's Crypt)

Amy said: "We can't guarantee you ghostly happenings, but we can guarantee a truly immersive experience at The Cage.

"Not only is The Cage now decorated and filled with timeless, period furniture, each with its own story, but it also houses a collection of artefacts telling the history of lock-ups in England.

"We host a curated museum showcasing over 100 historic artefacts and curiosities, and a large library of books about the paranormal, witchcraft and the occult."

Guests interested in investigating the building's paranormal reputation will also have access to equipment designed for conducting their own experiments.

CCTV monitors the property around the clock and could, the owners say, capture unusual activity during guests’ stays.

The Cage has long attracted attention from paranormal enthusiasts due to stories of unexplained phenomena linked to the building, which once served as the village lock-up.

Bookings are open for stays from November 2026, with prices starting at £350 a night. Discounts are available for multiple-night stays.

Those brave enough to spend the night can find further information and booking details online.

Haunted - The Cage in St Osyth (Image: Amy's Crypt)

The cottage’s oldest section, known as The Cage, held prisoners accused of witchcraft.

A plaque on the side of the house describes the plight of Ursula Kemp, a St Osyth woman called upon by her neighbours to heal ailments and sickness.

She was accused, tried and convicted of witchcraft before being hanged in 1582. Men, women and children were detained in The Cage until 1908.

Vanessa Mitchell, who owned the house from 2004 to 2020, fled after claiming she was physically attacked by spirits.

She said ghostly figures plagued her, pushed her over while she was pregnant and were followed by mysterious blood splatters.

The cottage has since been dubbed one of the UK’s most haunted houses.

Thirteen women accused of witchcraft were reportedly chained in The Cage before being hanged.
